# Results

*Generated by `tools/results_table.py` from `docs/results.csv` and `docs/results-phase9.csv`. Do not edit by hand: rerun `python3 tools/bench/run_all.py`, then the generator.*

Measured on Apple M5, 10 cores, 16 GiB, macOS 26.6.2, measured 2026-10-03 on AC power. Real `raftkvd` processes on one machine, driven by `raftkvload` (closed-loop clients, 16-byte values), durable fsync unless stated. Throughput figures are the median of three 10 s runs (build-type rows: one run). They compare configurations on this laptop; they are not a claim about production hardware.

## Throughput and latency

| Cluster size (writes, 32 clients) | Throughput | Write p50 | Write p99 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 node | 2,493 ops/s | 12.1 ms | 30.3 ms |
| 3 nodes | 815 ops/s | 37.3 ms | 84.5 ms |
| 5 nodes | 558 ops/s | 53.3 ms | 126.8 ms |

| Reads vs writes (3 nodes, 8 clients, 50% writes) | p50 | p99 |
|---|---|---|
| Get (through the log) | 32.2 ms | 65.0 ms |
| Put | 32.2 ms | 66.1 ms |

## Under failure and by configuration

| Measurement | Result |
|---|---|
| Writes resume after `kill -9` of the leader (3 nodes, 5 kills) | median 291 ms, worst 301 ms |
| One follower stopped (`SIGSTOP`; stands in for a minority partition) | 877 ops/s, vs 815 with all three |
| Group commit: one fsync per batch vs per request | 912 vs 236 ops/s (**3.9×**) |
| Batching: up to 64 entries per `AppendEntries` vs 1 | 805 vs 87 ops/s (**9.2×**) |
| Durable fsync vs none (unsafe) | 785 vs 114,500 ops/s |
| Servers built release | 744 ops/s |
| Servers built asan+ubsan | 894 ops/s |
| Servers built tsan | 884 ops/s |
| 20% message drops (simulator, virtual time) | 18.7% of normal throughput |

## Snapshots

| State size | Take (serialize) | Restore | Save durably + compact |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1,000 keys | 0.06 ms | 0.13 ms | 16.71 ms |
| 10,000 keys | 0.64 ms | 1.54 ms | 16.80 ms |
| 100,000 keys | 6.20 ms | 14.90 ms | 23.34 ms |

One log append plus sync takes 3,832 µs with fsync and 4.6 µs without.

## Before and after the final improvements

Phase 9 measured the first complete version. Three changes followed: group commit, an adaptive client timeout, and PreVote/CheckQuorum.

| | Phase 9 | Now |
|---|---|---|
| Writes per second, 3 nodes, 32 clients | 210 ops/s | 815 ops/s |
| Write latency p50, 3 nodes, 32 clients | 154.6 ms | 37.3 ms |
| Write latency p99, 3 nodes, 32 clients | 200.5 ms | 84.5 ms |
| Writes resume after `kill -9` of the leader (median) | 495 ms | 291 ms |
| 20% message drops (simulated) | 5.2% of normal | 18.7% of normal |

## Predictions

Committed in [`raftkv.md`](../raftkv.md) §7 before anything was measured, and scored against the Phase 9 measurements, the version they were made about.

| Prediction | Measured | Verdict |
|---|---|---|
| 3 → 5 nodes costs about 25% of write throughput | 7.3% | ✗ wrong: much smaller |
| Writes resume within 1000 ms of `kill -9` of the leader | median 495 ms, worst 503 ms | ✓ held |
| Batching gives about 2× | 3.4× | ✗ wrong: underestimated |
